recognition.prompt: Scratch the back of your head.
Rest a hand on top of your head.
Put both hands on your hips.
Give a thumbs-up during a conversation.
Rub your chin as though thinking.

murders.title: Sticker
murders.instruction: Put a sticker on your chosen person’s clothing.

murders.title: Hold an object
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to hold an object for you.

murders.title: Pass an object
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to pass you an object.

murders.title: Pick up an object
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to pick up an object you have dropped.

murders.title: Switch a light
murders.instruction: Turn the lights on or off with your chosen person in the room.

murders.title: Another room
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to follow you into another room.

murders.title: Fold some paper
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to fold a piece of paper.

murders.title: Read aloud
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to read something aloud.

murders.title: Tell a joke
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to tell you a joke.

murders.title: Sing a few words
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to sing a few words of a song.

murders.title: Say thank you
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to say “thank you” to you.

murders.title: Answer with a number
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to answer a question with a number.

murders.title: Finish a phrase
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to finish a familiar phrase you start.

murders.title: Wave back
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to wave back at you.

murders.title: Clap their hands
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to clap their hands.

murders.title: Copy a gesture
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to copy a gesture you make.

murders.title: Explain how
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to explain how to do something.

murders.title: Say I don’t know
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to say “I don’t know”.

murders.title: Say cheers
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to say “cheers” to you.

murders.title: Bless you
murders.instruction: Pretend to sneeze and get your chosen person to say “bless you”.

murders.title: High-five
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to give you a high-five.

murders.title: Fist bump
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to give you a fist bump.

murders.title: Look over there
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to look at something you point to.

murders.title: Swap places
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to swap seats or places with you.

murders.title: Say What?
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to say “What?” to you.

murders.title: Say please
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to say “please” to you.

murders.title: Nod in agreement
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to nod in answer to a question.

murders.title: Make a choice
murders.instruction: Offer your chosen person two options and get them to choose one.

murders.title: Ask a question
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to ask you a question.

murders.title: Rock, paper, scissors
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to play a round of rock, paper, scissors with you.

murders.title: Join the countdown
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to join you in counting down from five.
